svg.text: Appendix: v4 deployment and where the delay sits
v4 = background at a fixed rate, only targets controlled; the one model with real congestion and distinct rates at once
Left: v4 cuts D_info from 244.8 to 116.6 ms (−52%) at nearly the same send volume; delivery falls 99% → 96%, a real loss.
Right: detection is ~100 ms in all four schemes; the difference is the wait after it — 61.8 ms (G0), 172.5 ms (G1), ~0 ms (G2/G3).
So the gain is attributable: it does not make detection faster, it stops the queue after detection.
